2607.25531.title: Multi-Scale Structural Features for Continual, Comprehensible Visual Recognition in a Developmental Learning Framework
2607.25531.paper_summary: Contemporary machine learning struggles to learn continually, reuse prior knowledge, and expose a comprehensible internal structure. A recently proposed developmental, gradient-free learning framework addresses these limitations by learning a discrete, topological model of its inputs through local variation and selection, yielding an inherent continual-learning guarantee: new observations refine existing structure without overwriting past knowledge, and without replay buffers or predefined task boundaries. Its extension to visual inputs demonstrated this principle on shape recognition, but relied on a feature representation of limited expressivity that capped recognition accuracy. We introduce a new visual feature representation that encodes shape structure across multiple scales, capturing edge and contour features together with their spatial relations, and integrate it with the network-refinement learning process; we further improve the learning dynamics and the read-out used to predict from the learned model. The study targets two-dimensional shape, with class-incremental MNIST as a controlled, interpretable benchmark in which continual-learning behavior can be measured directly. Our approach substantially increases accuracy over the prior representation, matching or exceeding replay- and regularisation-based baselines at comparable storage while storing no past data, and preserves the framework's defining behavior: earlier-learned classes are retained as new ones are introduced, with no destructive adaptation, and the learned representations remain human-interpretable. What separates the methods is retention: the baselines surrender most of a just-trained class within its own cycle and relearn it afterwards, which ours does not. 2607.25531.paper_summary_zh: 當代機器學習在持續學習、重用先前知識和揭示可理解的內部結構方面面臨挑戰。一個最近提出的發展性、無梯度學習框架通過局部變化和選擇學習其輸入的離散拓撲模型，解決了這些限制，從而產生了固有的持續學習保證：新的觀察會在不覆蓋過去知識的情況下，細化現有結構，且不需要重播緩衝區或預定任務邊界。它對視覺輸入的擴展在形狀識別上演示了這一原則，但依賴於表達能力有限的特徵表示，限制了識別準確性。我們引入了一種新的視覺特徵表示，該表示跨多個尺度編碼形狀結構，捕捉邊緣和輪廓特徵及其空間關係，並將其與網絡精煉學習過程整合；我們進一步改善了學習動態和用於從學習模型中預測的讀出方式。該研究針對二維形狀，以類別增量的 MNIST 作為可控的、可解釋的基準，能夠直接測量持續學習行為。我們的方法在準確性上顯著超過先前的表示，與重播和正則化基準相比，在可比的存儲下匹配或超越，且不存儲任何過去數據，並保持框架的定義行為：早期學習的類別在引入新類別時得以保留，沒有破壞性適應，且學習的表示仍然保持人類可解釋性。這些方法的區別在於保留：基準在其自身循環內放棄大部分剛訓練的類別，然後再重新學習，而我們的方法則不這樣做。其重要性在於學習的方式。該系統每次整合一個樣本，同時可證明其對...的反應保持不變。
